Container.Name: Patchboard
Container.Overview: A start page and control center for your server. It shows what needs you, your containers, storage, downloads and media, and lets you act on them. Connect Unraid itself in Apps for the array, pools and disks. Sign-in is off until you turn on a password in Settings, Connections, Sign-in and keys.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, boards, history and the encrypted keys.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Reads your containers, their logs and their stats.

Config.Name: Backup logs
Config.Description: A folder your backup scripts log to, for the Backups grid. docs/CONFIGURATION.md has the format.

Config.Name: Runbook
Config.Description: A folder with RUNBOOK.md, for runbook sections on container pages.
